comment.text: STAG2 R216 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include Biliary tract tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: biliarytract; Bladder tumors; Bone tumors; CNS tumors. Additional source tumor types are retained in the structured record. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.

applicability_notes: Confirm the exact allele and reference transcript: source protein numbering is not a validated clinical HGVS assertion.
Tumor counts describe source cohorts and may overlap between releases and sheets; they must not be added together.
An observed synonymous or stop allele is retained for source fidelity and is not automatically classified as oncogenic.
FDA references are separate gene-level evidence until the exact biomarker, tumor, setting, and current label have been checked.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting STAG2 residue R216 have been observed in bladder tumors, bone tumors, and uterine tumors.
